title: Api proposal: allow searchBox to reuse an <input>
body:
Following discussions we had in #25, here's the "final" proposal:
- [x] reimplement the searchBox widget using vanilla JavaScript to allow enhancing an already present `input` instead of generating a complete markup
- [x] automatically detect if the container is an <input> and bind to it, otherwise generate the DOM like right now

This issue was created to aboid confusions when reading all conversations in #25
